description: Finds every FACE in a video clip and stores one independent path per person — position, size and head rotation (nod/turn/tilt) per frame. Queued, not immediate: poll list_face_tracks until state is 'ready'. Re-running on the same clip REPLACES its previous run and keeps the same trackId, so clips already bound stay bound. A person who leaves the shot and returns much later becomes a SECOND face on purpose — use merge_faces if they are the same person.

clipId.description: The video clip to scan, from get_timeline.

holdSeconds.description: How long a vanished face is still 'the same face' when it comes back (default 1).

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

travelFaces.description: How far it may reappear from where it vanished, in face widths (default 0.8).

name: track_faces
title: Track faces
